title: How Mechanisms Work
grammar: Process Reflexives (-ódik/-ődik), Procedural Connectors & Technical Descriptions
goal: I can say that a process happens by itself, using verbs like megoldódik and átalakul.
I can say that something takes place, using sor kerül vmire and végbemegy.
I can name a process, an operation, machinery and regulation (működés, folyamat, gépezet, szabályozás).
